*/logged-out-account:ordinary-lead-not-l: REPORTED, NOT FIXED. A lead that lands on an expired-session account is written to the sheet as Stage 'Skipped: Session expired' while the log says 'Retry next run'. Cold-lead modes only pick blank-Stage rows (src/campaign.js ~2874), so it is never retried, and the healthy account does not take it over in the same run.
open_profile_only/bad-leads:sheet-never-: REPORTED, NOT FIXED. When LinkedIn rejects a multi-line message and the text stays in the composer, sendMessage's post-send check (src/linkedin/actions.js, 'foundInThread') still passes: it compares composer textContent (no line breaks) against body innerText (breaks collapsed to spaces). Lead is stamped 'OP Sent' though nothing was sent. Triggered when the last 40 chars span a line break (e.g. a sign-off).
introduce_back/bad-leads:sheet-never-cla: REPORTED, NOT FIXED. sendIntroViaCleanCompose (src/linkedin/actions.js) never verifies the intro actually left the composer (waits 1.5s, logs success). A rejected send is stamped 'IC Sent', and Intro Status is one-shot, so it is never retried.
*/acceptance-followup:sheet-values-are-c: REPORTED, NOT FIXED. src/linkedin/auto-intro.js:236 and src/linkedin/auto-dm.js:29 define `ord` as a function but write `${day}${ord}` without calling it, so the follow-up's dateLastAction is the function's SOURCE CODE. The sheet's Date/Time columns fall back to now() for non-ISO strings, but the Audit Log tab's Date cell (google-apps-script.js:1838) receives the code text for every intro/DM.
introduce_back/start-gates:start-refuses: REPORTED, NOT FIXED. A sheet whose LinkedIn URL column is blank on every row is ACCEPTED when Start is pressed for an Introduction Campaign ('Campaign started'), while the other four campaign types refuse it with 'No actionable leads were found. The campaign was not started.' Cause (src/launch-validation.js:2): introduce_back is not in ACTION_MODES, so the zero-actionable-leads refusal is skipped for it. Effect: a wrong URL column starts a campaign that then has nothing to do. Only the 'no-linkedin-urls-in-sheet' case differs; the other bad setups are refused correctly.
